legend.note: Hand-curated names and our own one-liners; ? stands for the precision letters s, d, c and z.
legend.generic: lapack95 and blas95 map each generic name to the LAPACK families of its precision variants (lapack.json groups); an empty list marks an MKL extension

modules.lapack95: Fortran 95 interfaces to LAPACK: generic names (getrf) with optional arguments
modules.blas95: Fortran 95 interfaces to BLAS: generic names (gemm) with optional arguments
modules.f95_precision: the kind parameters (wp, sp, dp) of lapack95 and blas95
modules.mkl_vsl: vector statistics: random numbers, convolution, summary statistics
modules.mkl_vsl_type: the types and constants of mkl_vsl

extensions.?gemmt: Matrix-matrix product that computes only the upper or lower triangle of the result.
extensions.?gemm_batch: Computes groups of matrix-matrix products in one call.
extensions.?gemm_batch_strided: Computes matrix-matrix products of matrices at a fixed stride, in one call.
extensions.?gemm3m: Complex matrix-matrix product with three real products instead of four.
extensions.i?amin: Index of the element with the smallest absolute value.
extensions.?imatcopy: Scales and transposes a matrix in place.
extensions.?omatcopy: Scales and transposes a matrix out of place.
extensions.?omatadd: Scales, transposes and adds two matrices.
extensions.?getrf_batch: LU factorisations of groups of matrices in one call.
extensions.?getrs_batch: Solves with groups of LU factorisations in one call.
extensions.mkl_set_num_threads: Sets the number of threads MKL uses.
extensions.mkl_get_max_threads: Returns the number of threads MKL may use.
extensions.mkl_set_num_threads_local: Sets the number of MKL threads for the calling thread only.
extensions.mkl_domain_set_num_threads: Sets the number of threads for one MKL domain (BLAS, FFT, …).
extensions.mkl_set_dynamic: Lets MKL lower its number of threads, or stops it.
extensions.mkl_get_dynamic: Returns whether MKL may lower its number of threads.
extensions.mkl_free_buffers: Frees the memory MKL keeps in its buffers.
extensions.mkl_realloc: Changes the size of memory from mkl_malloc.
extensions.mkl_get_version_string: Returns the MKL version as text.
extensions.mkl_verbose: Turns MKL’s verbose mode on or off.
extensions.mkl_cbwr_set: Sets the conditional numerical reproducibility mode.
extensions.mkl_enable_instructions: Limits the instruction sets MKL dispatches to.

env.MKL_NUM_THREADS: The number of threads MKL uses.
env.MKL_DYNAMIC: Whether MKL may lower its number of threads.
env.MKL_DOMAIN_NUM_THREADS: The number of threads per MKL domain.
env.MKL_ENABLE_INSTRUCTIONS: The newest instruction set MKL may dispatch to.
env.MKL_VERBOSE: Prints the MKL calls and their timings.
env.MKL_THREADING_LAYER: The threading layer of the single dynamic library (INTEL, SEQUENTIAL, GNU, TBB).
env.MKL_INTERFACE_LAYER: LP64 or ILP64 integers, for the single dynamic library.

links.rule: see lapack.json and scalapack.json; intel.com answers scripts with 403

?omatcopy.s: Scales and transposes a matrix out of place.

?imatcopy.s: Scales and transposes a matrix in place.

?geadd.s: Adds two scaled matrices: C := a*A + b*C.

?gemmt.s: Matrix-matrix product that computes only the upper or lower triangle of the result.

sbgemm.s: Matrix-matrix product in bfloat16, accumulated in single precision.

shgemm.s: Matrix-matrix product in half precision, accumulated in single precision.

openblas_set_num_threads.s: Sets the number of threads OpenBLAS uses.

openblas_get_num_threads.s: Returns the number of threads OpenBLAS uses.

openblas_get_num_procs.s: Returns the number of processors OpenBLAS sees.

openblas_get_parallel.s: Returns how OpenBLAS was built to run in parallel: none, threads or OpenMP.

openblas_get_config.s: Returns the options OpenBLAS was built with.

openblas_get_corename.s: Returns the name of the CPU core OpenBLAS optimises for.

openblas_set_affinity.s: Pins an OpenBLAS thread to CPUs.

env.OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: The number of threads OpenBLAS uses.
env.OPENBLAS_DEFAULT_NUM_THREADS: The number of threads when no other setting applies.
env.OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT: How long idle threads wait before they sleep.
env.OPENBLAS_VERBOSE: Prints the core OpenBLAS chose (2) or more.
env.OPENBLAS_CORETYPE: Forces the CPU core type of a dynamic-architecture build.
env.OPENBLAS_BLOCK_FACTOR: Scales the blocking of the BLAS kernels.

modules.cublas: cuBLAS, with the BLAS names overloaded for device arrays
modules.cublas_v2: the cuBLAS v2 interfaces, which take a handle
